messages:
amy_sales: Heads up — AcmeSys returned our MSA + DPA with a set of redlines. They also said they will only issue a PO before the Order Form is countersigned. Key asks: net45 payment term, HSM clause, auditor access to logs, and explicit PO reference to Order Form. POC is live; customer says provisioning waits on PO. Link to redlines: https://acme.docs/redlines.pdf

lila_ops: @amy can you confirm billing contact and whether we accept PO-first for POCs? this will change provisioning flow.

marco_finance: We can accept net45 for enterprise but need preauth controls. Options: 1) Accept PO as commitment and invoice net45; require W-9/taxid and contact. 2) If MSA unsigned, require 1 month prepay or trial credit cap. Which does sales prefer?

dan_legal: Quick summary of redlines: they changed Limitation of Liability, added IP carveouts, and expanded DPA auditor access. They want Order Form to be explicitly contingent on their PO. Recommend two paths: (A) allow PO + 30d to sign MSA with an amendment capturing provisional access; (B) escalate to GC for commercial exceptions if they insist on stronger indemnities. I'll draft a narrow amendment today.

priya_sec: Security flag: they requested pen test report, SOC2 Type II (we have), and an HSM attestation we don't currently publish. For HSM/KMS integration we'll need to scope with Private/Dedicated team — leads time ~2w. @trey_se do we have a sandbox path without HSM for the POC?

trey_se: For POC we can spin up a Dedicated sandbox with KMS placeholder (no full HSM attestation) and restrict data retention. Timeline ~10 business days to provision if infra approves. For performance, HSM gating may add latency. Suggest temporary mitigations: enable prefix KV caching + batching. Example quick config: `batch_size: 16` `cache_enabled: true` `quantization: 4-bit` — reduces cost and risk while we finalize HSM scope.

amy_sales: Customer insists they cannot start until PO is in. They said PO will be delivered today but will reference the Order Form number. Do we accept 'PO + 30 days to sign MSA' as a standard compromise?

dan_legal: We can accept PO + 30d to sign if PO explicitly states it is for "provisional access under existing terms" and references the Order Form. I'll prepare an amendment that: (1) limits provisional liability, (2) requires MSA signature in 30 days or prepay kicks in, (3) preserves IP protections. I can have a redline by EOD.

marco_finance: Also need billing contact, tax info, and the PO PDF (scan). If international, need VAT details. If they want invoice flow, ensure PO references the billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. and include legal entity tax id.

lila_ops: Action items: Dan -> draft amendment by EOD; Marco -> confirm billing path and whether W-9/VAT required by tomorrow; Priya -> pull SOC2 summary and note on HSM attestation; Trey -> confirm sandbox provisioning estimate and any perf caveats; Amy -> get PO PDF and customer billing contact.

amy_sales: Confirmed billing contact: sara@acmesys.com. They said PO# 987654 and will attach PDF. Sample PO snippet they sent in chat: "PO# 987654 — Net45 — Bill to Redwood Inference Inc — OrderFormRef: OF-2026-332" I'll upload when received.

trey_se: One more note: if we provision before MSA, lock down telemetry and retention to POC defaults (14d purge) and disable exports. That reduces audit surface.

dan_legal: Agreed. Provisioning ok under trial credit + amendment language. I'll include the provisional access clause and an expiration if MSA not signed.

amy_sales: Great. If PO lands today, I'll post PDF here. If we need GC escalation I will loop execs. :thumbsup:
